title: Erasure law for symbol-indexed rows
statement: For every type $A$, every reader that returns an $A$-value and remaining suffix or fails on a bit string, and every bit string $x$, discarding the decoded row and retaining only the remaining suffix from the three-entry row reader gives exactly the result of applying the value-discarding version of the given reader three times in sequence.
hypotheses_covered: A reader from bit strings to optional pairs of an A-value and suffix
replaced:
For every field reader with values in a type $A$ and every bit string $x$:
discarding the parsed row from the three-symbol row reader equals iterating the
value-discarding version of the field reader three times.
